## Summary

**Browser research failed:** The `browser_research` tool is broken (internal `_BridgeLLM`/pydantic incompatibility — fails on every call before the browser even launches). I pivoted to the sandboxed live KalshiML production dashboard, which contains richer, quantified edge data than a manual Kalshi browse would have yielded anyway.

## Most promising findings (from live model-vs-market analysis, 2026-08-03 ~05:00 UTC)

The system tracks 244 market cells across Kalshi daily city HIGH/LOW temperature markets (cheap/mid/rich price buckets) and NYC hourly temperature (NYCH). Edge = model estimate minus market price, in cents.

**Strongest apparent mispricings (daily NO side, "mid" bucket — these have adequate samples):**
- **Chicago LOW mid [NO]** — edge **+30¢**, n=38 (but calibration off by 47pt — needs more data)
- **Boston HIGH mid [NO]** — edge **+29¢**, n=33
- **Houston HIGH mid [NO]** — edge **+27¢**, n=48
- **New Orleans HIGH mid [NO]** — edge **+27¢**, n=52
- **Seattle HIGH mid [NO]** — edge **+26¢**, n=43
- **Phoenix LOW mid [NO]** — edge **+26¢**, n=35
- New York HIGH mid [NO] +24¢, Chicago HIGH mid [NO] +24¢, Philadelphia LOW mid [NO] +24¢

**Best risk-adjusted (calibration passes, not just edge):**
- **San Francisco HIGH mid [NO]** — edge +16¢, n=43, calib 9pt — only daily cell in PROBATION (closest to tradeable)
- **Atlanta LOW mid [NO]** — edge +4¢, calib 5pt — small but clean
- **Seattle HIGH rich [YES]** — edge +6¢, calib 2pt
- **Miami LOW rich [YES]** — edge +4¢, calib 9pt

**Hourly (NYC temp):** NYCH 30-15 D3 [NO] is in PROBATION with +3¢ edge, n=359, calib 1pt — well-calibrated but thin edge. A settle-hour split shows morning-settle NO cells carry +5–6¢ edge.

**Key structural inefficiency:** A systematic asymmetry — YES sides of daily mid-bucket cells show −20 to −40¢ edge while NO sides show +15 to +30¢. The market appears to systematically overprice YES on mid-range temperature brackets vs. a multi-model weather ensemble (HRRR leads the model leaderboard, brier 0.121). The "cheap" bucket shows even larger raw edges (NO up to +90¢) but with tiny samples and poor calibration — likely illiquid longshots, not yet trustworthy.

**Caveats:** No cell is currently ARMED (0 armed, 3 probation, 241 learning); the would-bet paper record is −2.2¢/contract overall (36% win), so edges are real but haven't yet cleared the margin after fees. Economic-indicator contracts were not covered due to the browser outage.
